skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 3 consecutive strikes to a single target, each dealing 50% ATK Direct DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants [Berserk] to self, adding charge DMG equal to 380% ATK. Strikes the main target 3 times for 40% ATK Direct DMG each, then performs a [Continuous Pursuit] on the 2 enemies with the lowest HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Berserk] charge DMG 380% > 420% ATK. Lowest-HP enemies pursued by [Continuous Pursuit] 2 > 3. Per-hit Direct DMG on the main target 40% > 50% ATK. Additionally heals self for 12% max HP on each strike.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Permanently grants [Immunity against Stun] to other allies in its row. After 2 rounds, grants itself [Immunity against Extra DMG].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Self [Immunity against Extra DMG]: after 2 rounds > after 1 round.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Self [Immunity against Extra DMG]: after 1 round > permanent (from the start).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When Metal Bat dies, he revives (zombie-like, up to 3 times, and can revive even when all other allies have died). Upon reviving, he gains 40% Max HP and performs [Ultimate] on the lowest-HP enemy.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Revive count 3 > 4 times. Revival heal 40% > 70% Max HP. [Ultimate] targets 1 > 3 enemies.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Attack buffs increase damage based on conditions (e.g. each marked enemy), amplifying the amount of Fury-type damage the unit deals.
Status that causes the bearer to be unaffected by a certain effect or type of control, such as [Breakthrough], Stun, or Charm.
Extra attacks outside of turn (usually after an ally acts) apply a portion of the ultimate's ST and effects to a random target, at no mana cost.
